newsitem.title: USA: Express Capital Concepts in reverse merger.
newsitem.headline: Express Capital Concepts in reverse merger.

text.p: Express Capital Concepts Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire privately held GreyStone Technology of San Diego.
In the reverse acquisition merger, GreyStone will swap its stock for Express Capital's shares and change the company's name and listing, a GreyStone spokesman said.
He added Express capital, which now has about 20 million shares outstanding will do a reverse split to reach about 480,000 shares and then swap its shares one-for-one with GreyStone's.
Express Capital's chief executive Earnest Mathis said in a statement the transaction "offers GreyStone an expedient and cost-effective entry into the public markets."
GreyStone is a developer of three-dimensional interactive software.
Express shares rose 3/8 to 7/8 Tuesday morning.
